review.assessment: The diff replaces a reverse-iteration accumulation loop with a forward iteration that explicitly adds or subtracts the next term on each step. This corrects the associativity of chained subtraction so expressions like `10 - 3 - 2` are evaluated left-to-right as `(10 - 3) - 2` instead of right-to-left. The change aligns additive evaluation with standard arithmetic rules without touching precedence logic or other parsing stages.
